settings.title: Check the route in
settings.text: Measure the width and height of every door, corridor, stairwell and lift the piece must pass through.

settings.title: Compare with the product
settings.text: Use the dimensions on each product page. The diagonal depth matters for sofas and wardrobes.

settings.title: Mark it out
settings.text: Outline the footprint on the floor with tape or newspaper to see how it feels in the room.

settings.label: Behind dining chairs
settings.value: At least 90 cm to pull out and walk past

settings.label: Around a bed
settings.value: At least 60 cm on each accessible side

settings.heading: Prefer we measure for you?
settings.text: Book a consultation and our team can help you measure and plan the space.
